lessons.title: Lesson 1: Community activities and volunteering vocabulary
objectives: Nắm vững các khái niệm và định nghĩa cốt lõi của Lesson 1: Community activities and volunteering vocabulary.
Hiểu và áp dụng thành thạo các quy tắc và công thức trong SGK.
Rèn luyện kỹ năng phân tích và giải quyết các bài toán/tình huống thực tiễn.

concepts.definition: Describes actions that started and finished at a specific, definite time in the past.
concepts.example: Last summer, our youth club planted 200 trees in the community park.
concepts.essence: Common time markers: yesterday, last week, 2 days ago, in 2020.

rules.meaning: Pronounced /t/ after voiceless sounds (/p, k, f, s, ʃ, tʃ/); /ɪd/ after /t, d/; and /d/ after voiced sounds.
rules.essence: The physical ease of voice chord vibration determines how -ed is pronounced.

workedExamples.prompt: Put the verb in brackets into the correct past tense: 'We (donate) __________ warm clothes to street children last winter.'
steps: Step 1: Time marker 'last winter' signals the Past Simple tense.
Step 2: 'Donate' is a regular verb ending in -e, so add -d: donated.
workedExamples.answer: We donated warm clothes to street children last winter.

commonMistakes.mistake: Using the base form or past participle when asking questions with 'Did'.
commonMistakes.why: In questions and negatives, the auxiliary 'did' takes the past marker, so the main verb must return to its bare infinitive: 'Did you donate...?' not 'Did you donated...?'
